name: ape_player_daemon_bidirectional_contract
purpose: Bidirectional contract for APE VPS HEVC-UHD Crystal-first playback policy, QoE feedback, installer-anchor metadata, ADB bootstrap, and wake-on-playback.

playlist_metadata.semantics: Pointers for compatible components; ignored by standard HLS players that do not understand them.

qoe_fallback_policy.primary: Prefer HEVC/HVC1/HEV1 UHD Crystal when decoder support and QoE are viable.

deployment_notes.bootstrap: Run from host with ADB installed and device authorization already granted.
deployment_notes.wake: Use Nginx/Lua log phase or API beacon to enqueue non-blocking wake events consumed by a worker.
deployment_notes.validation: Separate local static checks from production VPS and device checks.
